description: Detects the musical key of a track and its Camelot code. Input: one file with a public HTTPS download_url. Returns the measurements as JSON, not a file. The server downloads the file from download_url, keeps it in ihateaudio's Cloudflare R2 storage while the job runs, and processes it with the ihateaudio.com tool page in a headless browser on Cloudflare. The input is deleted when the job ends.

download_url.description: Public HTTPS link to the audio or video file. The server downloads it from here.

file_id.description: Set by ChatGPT for files shared in the chat. Other clients leave it out.

name: key_finder
title: Key Finder
